result.markdown:
# Call setup failures and dropped sessions at S-SUD-008

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** bad_change at `AGG-SUD-01`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence from configuration change CHG-2026-0025 matching the KPI degradation onset, with maintenance and site scope verified.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-11 02:15 to not established or ongoing
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-11 02:27
- **Affected:** S-SUD-008, S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, S-SUD-006

## Summary

A configuration push of template OPT-17 to AGG-SUD-01 degraded admission control and RRC timers across connected sites.

RRC success rate dropped and drop rates spiked across multiple sites starting 2026-09-11 02:15.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-11 02:15: Earliest onset of rrc_success_pct degradation at S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-005. [T1, T8, T10, ANM-000140]
- 2026-09-11 02:27: Config push CHG-2026-0025 applied template OPT-17 to AGG-SUD-01. [CHG-2026-0025]
- 2026-09-11 02:30: Drop rate spike ongoing at S-SUD-008. [ANM-000145]
- 2026-09-11 03:07: Minor RRC_FAILURE_RATE_HIGH alarm raised on S-SUD-008. [ALM-000193]

## Evidence

- Alert ALR-0017 indicates ongoing anomaly across four sites including S-SUD-008 and S-SUD-002 starting 2026-09-11 02:15. [T1, ALR-0017]
- S-SUD-008 depends on aggregation router AGG-SUD-01 via fiber link LNK-SUD-01-B. [T2, S-SUD-008]
- Configuration push CHG-2026-0025 pushed RAN parameter template OPT-17 to AGG-SUD-01 at 2026-09-11 02:27. [CHG-2026-0025]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on the affected sites and their ancestors between query windows. [T5]
- Sites S-SUD-008, S-SUD-002, S-SUD-005, and S-SUD-006 all exhibited rrc_success_pct below baseline and drop rate deviations starting at 2026-09-11 02:15. [T8, T10]

## Hypotheses

1. **bad_change** at AGG-SUD-01: confirmed. Configuration change CHG-2026-0025 pushed template OPT-17 to AGG-SUD-01 right at the onset of multi-site degradation, matching runbook RB-BAD-CHANGE#05 pattern. [CHG-2026-0025, RB-BAD-CHANGE#05]
2. **transport_degradation** at LNK-SUD-01-B: rejected. No fiber link alarms or transport degradation indicators were found, and configuration changes perfectly correlate with the multi-site outage. [T3, CHG-2026-0025]

## Ruled out

- ALM-000189: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-SUD-005 occurred hours prior on 2026-09-10 and cleared well before the incident onset.
- ALM-000190: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarms on S-SUD-005 cleared on 2026-09-10 22:47, unrelated to the 02:15 accessibility degradation.
- ALM-000191: Minor VSWR_HIGH alarm on S-SUD-005 cleared at 23:19 on 2026-09-10 and is unrelated.
- T5: No maintenance windows were scheduled that could account for the simultaneous degradation across the four sites.

## Recommended actions

- Roll back configuration change CHG-2026-0025 on aggregation router AGG-SUD-01.
- Monitor RRC success rates and drop rates on S-SUD-008 and peer sites for recovery.
- Verify admission control and RRC timer parameter settings on template OPT-17.
